text:
deploy-bot: Deployment complete: release=redwood-api v0.42.3 -> prod-us-west (canary 15%). Running post-deploy smoke suite now. 

deploy-bot: Smoke report: 12 tests run, 9 ok, 3 degraded. Failures: embed-synth p95=1.8s (baseline 1.1s), kv-warmup miss rate spike, heartbeat-checker drift observed on 2 hosts. Logs attached. :warning:

jen: seeing the same in dashboards, p95 up but error rates low. Might be warmup timing.

mike: can you paste the failing probe log?

deploy-bot: ```
probe=embed-synth id=embed-probe-3 status=degraded p95=1.82s traces=high
kv_warmup: misses=312 -> baseline=28
heartbeat: last_ok=8s_ago (expected <2s) host=i-0a3f
```

lee: kv warmup jump looks like cache prefill didn't run on the new variant nodes. Did autoscaler replace hosts mid-rollout?

ops-bot: Autoscaler event: scale_up group=dedicated-pool-3 at 2024-11-07T22:12:01Z (added 4 nodes). No failures recorded on launch.

sara: quick decision: do we pin traffic back to v0.42.2 in prod-us-west, or try a fast mitigation (increase prefill delay + retry warmup)? We have 15% canary currently.

mike: prefer mitigation first: pinning is disruptive for customers depending on feature flags. Try bumping kv prefill concurrency and re-run smoke. If still fail, rollback.

oncall-sre: agreed with mike. I'll run a quick job to increase prefill concurrency to 10 and extend prefill timeout to 90s.

jen: I'm going to re-run embed-synth locally against canary variant to reproduce. Leaving traces on.

deploy-bot: Action: apply-config: prefill.concurrency=10 prefill.timeout=90s -> canary group=prod-us-west/variant-a. Re-running smoke in 30s. 

(30s later)

deploy-bot: Re-run results: 12 tests run, 11 ok, 1 degraded. Remaining: embed-synth p95=1.45s (better), heartbeat drift resolved on host i-0a3f, kv misses reduced to 42.

sara: nice improvement. Does anyone see regression risk if we continue rollout?

lee: no data suggesting correctness regressions. Perf improved after prefill tweak. My only ask: let's keep canary at 15% for another 10m and watch p95.

mike: +1. Keep canary pinned at 15% and enable 10m extended observation window. Create follow-up ticket to root-cause autoscaler interaction.

jen: filing ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4729 "kv prefill missed during quick scale_up causing embed-synth p95 spike". Assigning to eng-runtime.

oncall-sre: I'll monitor heartbeats and deploy health dashboards. If p95 creeps >1.6s or kv misses >100, rollback plan: pin traffic to v0.42.2 and open rollback window.

deploy-bot: Canary hold: traffic=15% pinned, observation_window=10m, rollback_thresholds={p95>1600ms or kv_miss>100}.

sara: thanks. After 10m if stable we can continue progressive rollout to 50% then 100%. Document the prefill knob in release notes for rollout playbooks.

mike: I'll add a short note to the release notes: "v0.42.3: adjusted kv prefill defaults; if you see warmup misses during scale events, increase prefill.concurrency and timeout."

jen: follow-up: local run produced a small MEM spike on variant-a at startup (not sustained). I've captured heap dump and uploaded to #eng-releases-artefacts.

lee: good catch. Add it to the ticket.

ops-bot: Incident watch created: INF-WATCH-2024-11-07-01 for v0.42.3 canary. Participants: oncall-sre, eng-runtime, deploy-eng.

sara: summary: mitigation applied, canary stable so far, holding rollout for 10m observation. If thresholds breach we rollback. Ticket INF-4729 created to investigate root cause and autoscaler interaction.

mike: thanks all. I'll coordinate the gradual continue after observation window. :thumbsup:
